scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive proof via two independently complete binary de Bruijn enumerators and two gcd implementations; verification code and all 2048 records included. Self-review only; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only order-five cycles classified. Relation between connection denominator and 2-adic complexity is classical. The complete text of one directly relevant 2012 article on period-general 2-adic complexity was inaccessible; historical priority is not conclusively established.
title: Exact FCSR-denominator and reversal spectrum of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
